subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: After the timestamped-output bug is fixed, should backup create automatically delete stale OpenClaw-owned backup temp artifacts older than one hour?
rationale: The implementation deletes old backup staging and archive artifacts before a new run, which is a reasonable bug fix but also changes operator recovery/debug expectations for partial backup files.

options.title: Accept Guarded Sweep
options.body: Accept automatic cleanup for tightly matched OpenClaw backup temp artifacts under the one-hour grace and owner-marker guards after the matcher defect is fixed.

options.title: Require Explicit Recovery Surface
options.body: Require cleanup to move behind a doctor/fix or other explicit recovery action instead of deleting during backup startup.

options.title: Pause Startup Cleanup
options.body: Pause or close this PR if stale partial backup artifacts should remain inspectable until a broader recovery policy exists.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Sweep
recommendation.body: Accept automatic cleanup for tightly matched OpenClaw backup temp artifacts under the one-hour grace and owner-marker guards after the matcher defect is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original backup CLI and authored the extraction into the current backup infra module, making them the best history-backed routing candidate for cleanup-policy acceptance.
